sources.excerpt: Low Frequency Destroyer by Cosmic Terror | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Cosmic Terror Low Frequency Destroyer LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION FUZZ Description The Low Frequency Destroyer by Cosmic Terror Effects is a high-gain distortion and fuzz pedal specifically engineered for bass and down-tuned guitars. The circuit is based on the legendary D.A.M. Ezekiel 25:17, known for its extreme versatility and authoritative low-end presence. It features a four-position rotary clipping switch that allows users to select between different diode configurations, ranging from compressed silicon textures to wide-open LED crunch. The pedal includes a dedicated blend control to mix the dry signal with the distorted path, ensuring that the fundamental bass frequencies remain intact even at maximum saturation. Handcrafted in small batches in Dortmund, Germany, the unit is housed in a chemically etched enclosure with a unique patina finish. Its high-output circuit is designed to drive power amplifiers and heavy rigs with massive volume and string articulation. Each unit is built with deep love for the low end and released in limited runs—only a few created each year. Every Cosmic Terror effect is a rare creation, shaped by a passion for both parts and sound The Prophecy of Low Frequencies (after the Book of Ezekiel) And lo, I beheld a circuit forged in shadow, and its name was The Low Frequency Destroyer. It is based on the legendary D.A.M. Ezekiel 25:17. Our version of this classic isn’t just a bass distortion pedal — it’s the living incarnation of your wildest bass dreams. Our take on this legend is designed to unleash raw, authoritative grit with an ironclad low end, it delivers a tone that doesn’t merely cut through the mix… it commands it. THIS PEDAL IS THE MOST VERSATILE COSMIC TERROR DISTORTION EVER AND A MUST HAVE FOR ALL BASS PLAYERS! Whether you’re shaking walls with a bass or driving a guitar into uncharted heaviness, the LFD responds with depth, clarity, and unstoppable force. From tight, articulate drive to explosive, speaker-pushing distortion, this circuit retains every ounce of low-frequency power. Clean blends remain pristine, distortion stays massive, and every setting feels as if the pedal itself is shaking the ground beneath you. The Low Frequency Destroyer pushes the legacy even further: • A four-mode clipping selector that unlocks entirely different voices Choose between germanium warmth, silicon diodes with the Sonic Doom bite, LED headroom like the Turbo RAT Distortion, or a fat, high-impact op-amp clipping mode — each one a distinct drive personality. • A clean blend that preserves your fundamental as an unholy, thunderous core The Rites of Control Drive – The engine of destruction.
